source.note: All three tickets were marked resolved by a human for the assignment after agent review. Resolution was status-only: no payment, purchase, fulfillment, stock reservation, or outside contact occurred.

tickets.short_outcome: No CC-TEE-WHITE size S was available (short 1). Vendor 1 was blocked by open, unpaid invoice 501 ($840, overdue on shop date 2026-08-31); its 5-day lead time was not guaranteed. The customer was not promised or contacted, and no payment or purchase was made.

agents.name: Boss
agents.did: Reviewed the ticket, delegated stock and vendor eligibility research to Inventory, and synthesized a cautious recommendation; did not pay or contact the customer.

agents.name: Inventory
agents.did: Checked exact SKU, size, quantity, vendor lead time, and shipping eligibility; delegated the invoice blocker lookup to Accounting.

agents.name: Accounting
agents.did: Checked invoice 501 and unpaid-invoice status; confirmed the $840 balance was overdue and blocking vendor shipment.

agents.name: Facilities
agents.did: Not involved; outside this ticket's scope.

agents.name: Customer Service
agents.did: A cautious customer update was drafted for review but not sent.

human_approvals.action: Marked ticket resolved through the human-confirmed backend route after agent review.

tickets.short_outcome: Facilities verified monthly rent of $2,400 is due 2026-09-02, two days after the shop date, so it was not yet overdue. Checking was $3,400. The prior rent-payment state was not verified; no payment or landlord contact occurred.

agents.name: Boss
agents.did: Reviewed the rent notice and delegated lease/due-date research to Facilities.

agents.name: Inventory
agents.did: Not involved; inventory was not needed for this rent ticket.

agents.name: Accounting
agents.did: Checked checking balance, unpaid invoices, and rent/payment records; reported the balance and the uncertainty around payment status without assuming future cash.

agents.name: Facilities
agents.did: Checked the lease and rent due date, then asked Accounting to verify cash and recorded payment information.

agents.name: Customer Service
agents.did: Not involved; no customer communication was needed.

human_approvals.action: Marked ticket resolved through the human-confirmed backend route after agent review.

tickets.short_outcome: Inventory found 8 of 20 requested CC-HOOD-NAVY size M (short 12). Accounting found no database-backed discount approval; $58 list price and $22 unit cost imply $1,160 at list for 20, arithmetic only—not an approved quote. Vendor shipment was blocked by invoice 501. No purchase or customer promise occurred.

agents.name: Boss
agents.did: Reviewed the bulk request, delegated stock availability to Inventory and pricing/discount review to Accounting, then synthesized the findings.

agents.name: Inventory
agents.did: Checked the exact hoodie SKU, size, requested quantity, and stock (8 available, 12 short); asked Accounting to verify pricing/discount facts.

agents.name: Accounting
agents.did: Checked pricing and discount authorization, calculated the $1,160 list-price total as arithmetic only, and verified the vendor/invoice shipping block.

agents.name: Facilities
agents.did: Not involved; facilities facts were unrelated to the bulk hoodie request.

agents.name: Customer Service
agents.did: Not involved; no customer message was finalized or sent.

human_approvals.action: Marked ticket resolved through the human-confirmed backend route after agent review.
